upload.dragDrop: Drop an Excel / PDF file here or
upload.supports: Excel: max 1,000 rows. PDF text/scan: max 10 pages. Max 10 MB.
upload.downloadHelp: Template includes column structure and format guidelines
upload.retryBatchId: Previous batch ID (when resubmitting a corrected file)
upload.retryBatchPlaceholder: Leave blank for a new import
upload.keepRowOrder: Use the previous batch ID only to correct failed rows; keep successful row contents unchanged. Start a new import for new purchases.

preview.warningSkip: Note: Only valid rows will be imported into the database. Invalid rows will be skipped.

openingInventory: Import sample opening inventory. Blank tags are generated on confirmation; new purchases require a receiving transaction.
receivingTitle: Add Excel / PDF assets to receiving draft
receivingHint: Valid rows are added to the draft. IT confirms the transaction before the assets enter stock.

guide.title: Import rules
guide.required: Asset name and type are required; Asset Tag may be blank and is generated on confirmation.
guide.unique: Asset Tag and Serial Number must be unique in the file and database.
guide.license: For licenses, enter software, assignment type, term and seat count; subscriptions need an expiry date.
guide.preview: Preview does not write to the database until confirmation.

ocr.hint: PDF is processed locally. Each page needs a table header using Excel column names or field keys, separated by | (use - for blank cells). Review every proposed value; PDF is not retained. Confirmation only adds valid rows; it never completes a receiving transaction.
ocr.changed: Values changed. Validate again before confirming.
